title: CI name has a wrong dash or a space at its start or end
cardHint: Small faults in a name, such as a space at the start or the end. SACM corrects them itself; nobody is asked.
cardText: Small faults in a name that SACM corrects itself, nobody is asked: an API offering that does not start with "API - " (for example another dash), and a space at the start or the end of a name.
